test_load_partial_checkpoint: test loading a partial checkpoint and verify epoch and iteration state is restored correctly
test_load_full_checkpoint: test loading a full checkpoint and verify training resumes from the next epoch
test_load_no_checkpoint: test training initialization when no checkpoint file exists on disk
test_finetune_from_model: test finetuning from a pretrained model and verify optimizer and scheduler are reset
test_finetune_from_model_resume: test resuming finetune from model when a local checkpoint already exists
